parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to delete all tags. This parameter takes effect only when the TagKey.N parameter is not specified. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ASM instance.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the ASM instances.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to `servicemesh`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type servicemesh --resource-id c418807cb4e5840eab018da7d8f5d0000 --tag-key TEST_KEY_1 --all false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 c418807cb4e5840eab018da7d8f5d0000 --TagKey.1 TEST_KEY_1 --ResourceType servicemesh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
